name: io.github.Dtsiakas/running-companion
title: Running Companion
description: Your own Garmin running and health data: readiness, runs, sleep, trends and patterns. Self-hosted.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: The Docker volume of your Running Companion install, where its database and settings are. Set it up first (see the README): this server reads that data, it doesn't create it.

volume.description: Name of the volume (companion-data with the README's docker run; <folder>_data with Docker Compose)
